label: More such package and mode of possession: degree-indexed induction controls

The coil causes and moves the workpiece in both heat respects; both have being and some heat formally; only the workpiece has heat at its own degree formally; the coil has both heat respects virtually; temperatures are 40 for the coil and 1000 for the workpiece. Encoding artifacts, disclosed: the temperatures and the surpassing relation are stipulated; the respect of being is caused by nothing. A structural surrogate of the case, not its evidence.
